title: coefficientHeart_commonStratification_refinement
statement: Let $X$ be a Noetherian scheme. Let $\Lambda$ be a commutative condensed ring (the coefficient is an unused parameter of the Lean statement). For every $n\in\mathbf N$ and every family $(P_j)_{j\in\{0,\ldots,n-1\}}$ of finite locally closed scheme stratifications of $X$ [def-constructible-stratification], there is a finite locally closed scheme stratification $R$ of $X$ such that every stratum image of $R$ is contained in a stratum image of every $P_j$, every scheme stratum of $R$ is connected [def-weil-connected-scheme], and, for every $0\leq k\leq |R|$, the union of the first $k$ stratum images is open in $X$. Refinement asserts containment of images only, with no factorization through the input scheme strata. The family of input stratifications may be empty and $X$ may be empty.

source.place: (1), finite common refinement and Noetherian induction for the open-prefix order

proof.text: Intersect the finite family of partitions using the finite product of their index types. The intersection for every tuple is locally closed, and choice of the stratum containing a point proves that these intersections cover X. For zero input partitions the empty product has one tuple and its intersection is X.

Induct on closed subsets S of the Noetherian space, uniformly for every finite locally closed cover of S. For nonempty S choose an irreducible component Z and a nonempty ambient open O contained in Z. Irreducibility puts Z inside the closure of one of the finitely many covering parts. Write this part as V intersect D with V open and D closed. Then U = O intersect V is nonempty, irreducible, open in S, and contained in that part. Apply induction to the proper closed complement S minus U, intersecting each covering part with the complement. Prepend U to its ordered irreducible refinement. Distinct pieces are disjoint. The complement of each initial union is a closed tail from the induction, so initial unions are open. The empty closed subset uses zero strata.

source.place: Tags 09Y5 and 0052; Noetherian closed-subset induction, with irreducible open pieces

proof.text: Realize every resulting locally closed Q as the vanishing-ideal closed subscheme of the open coborder of Q. Its inclusion followed by the open immersion has range Q. The immersion is a homeomorphism onto its range. Irreducibility of Q therefore gives an irreducible, hence connected, domain. Assemble the finite scheme stratification and the containment and open-prefix proofs.

lean.statement:
theorem coefficientHeart_commonStratification_refinement
    (Λ : Sheaf (coherentTopology Profinite.{u}) RingCat.{u + 1})
    [IsCommMonObj (coefficientHeartRingObj Λ)] (X : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian X] :
    ∀ (n : ℕ) (P : Fin n → X.FiniteLocallyClosedStratification),
      ∃ R : X.FiniteLocallyClosedStratification,
        (∀ (j : Fin n) (a : Fin R.n), ∃ b : Fin (P j).n,
          R.stratum a ⊆ (P j).stratum b) ∧
        (∀ a : Fin R.n, ConnectedSpace (R.domain a)) ∧
        ∀ k : Fin (R.n + 1),
          IsOpen (⋃ a : Fin R.n, ⋃ (_ : a.val < k.val), R.stratum a)
